item.title: John Carlson traded to Anaheim Ducks for draft picks
item.description: The Washington Capitals traded star defenseman John Carlson to the Anaheim Ducks for a conditional first-round pick in either the 2026 NHL Draft or the 2027 NHL Draft and a third-round pick in the 2027 NHL Draft. The deal was first reported by Sportsnet’s Elliotte Friedman. The Capitals officially announced the full trade moments later.
